description: Dept. of Local Government - NWP - Notification made under section 66 (c)  First Meeting of 18 Local Government Institutions. 2025
categorisation: This gazette notification specifically announces the scheduling of first meetings for the purpose of electing Mayors/Chairmen and Deputy Mayors/Vice Chairmen for various Local Government Institutions in the North Western Province. It falls under the Elections category as it deals with electoral processes for local government positions, including specific dates, times, and venues for these election meetings, and is made under the Local Government Institutes Elections Ordinance.
